## Purpose
Describe the user-visible problem or maintenance need addressed **in this repository**.

## Changes
Describe only changes made to the Community App Directory, including relevant files and behavior.

## Evidence
- [ ] I verified the changed behavior or documentation
- [ ] Required `catalog` CI checks pass
- [ ] Changes remain independent from non-public projects and systems
- [ ] Descriptions and displayed links are accurate and publicly sourced

## Catalog submissions (if applicable)
- Primary public source for the **application being listed**:
- Creator attribution and availability label:
- [ ] I regenerated the catalog outputs with `python scripts/build_site.py`
- [ ] The application has not been counted twice

## Publication checks
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, private reports or external application assets
- [ ] PR description is self-contained: no comparisons, references or credit to unrelated projects used as design or implementation examples
- [ ] No unsupported device-compatibility, safety, popularity or performance claims

**Note:** A link to an application being proposed for this directory is direct source evidence and should be included. External examples consulted during design are not part of the public PR narrative.
